expo.//: Two themes, dark and light — the OS decides which. Never pin this to one.
expo.//scheme: Watchers open a share link that deep-links straight into the session.
expo.//updates: DELIBERATELY NOT SET YET. Expo Go supplies its own runtime and does not support a custom runtimeVersion, so configuring one breaks the QR-code workflow. These only matter for a standalone EAS build, so they come back with the first real build: updates.url = https://u.expo.dev/938b4629-9a41-4ddf-bcd8-86bb4e4696b3 and runtimeVersion.policy = appVersion. That policy ties an over-the-air update to the app version it was built for, so JavaScript expecting newer native code can never land on an older build.
expo.//eas: EAS project id, updates and runtimeVersion are DELIBERATELY NOT SET. An EAS project id makes Expo Go prompt for an Expo login on every start, and a custom runtimeVersion is unsupported in Expo Go entirely — both break the scan-a-QR-code loop for no benefit during development. They matter only for a standalone build, so restore all three together with the first eas build: extra.eas.projectId = 938b4629-9a41-4ddf-bcd8-86bb4e4696b3, updates.url = https://u.expo.dev/938b4629-9a41-4ddf-bcd8-86bb4e4696b3, runtimeVersion.policy = appVersion.
